worklog-click-to-edit.title: Click any entry to edit
worklog-click-to-edit.body: Tap a work log entry to update its description or next action inline.

worklog-sprint-linking.title: Link entries to sprint tasks
worklog-sprint-linking.body: Use the task selector below the input to associate new entries with an active sprint task.

sprint-drag-drop.title: Drag to move tasks
sprint-drag-drop.body: Drag and drop cards between columns to update their status instantly.

sprint-next-action.title: Track your next action
sprint-next-action.body: Open a task and set a "next action" so you always know what to do when you return.

calendar-week-navigation.title: Browse past weeks
calendar-week-navigation.body: Scroll down to see earlier weeks. Each day shows your entry count and AI summary.

home-stats.title: Your logging streak
home-stats.body: WorkRecall tracks your daily logging streak. Log at least one entry each day to keep it going.

settings-auto-capture.title: Auto-capture works in the background
settings-auto-capture.body: Enable Automatic Work Logging to let WorkRecall capture your activity silently — no manual prompts needed.
